devMode.indicatorHint: Developer mode is on. Click to open the Developer tab in the left panel; turn it off from the View menu.

panel.title: Developer
panel.intro: Where you write and edit template code. Built-in templates are read-only; duplicate one into your own templates to edit it.

kindHints.animation: This animation was made in the animation editor; its code is generated from the animation document. Edit it in the animation workspace or the Animation code panel.
kindHints.user: Edit this template's files (in the built-in code editor or an external one). The preview reloads when you save.
kindHints.builtin: Built-in templates can't be edited directly. Duplicate it into your templates first, then open its code or folder.

panel.noTools: The code editor module (optional) isn't installed. Edit the files in the template folder with an external editor; the preview updates when you save.
panel.noDiagnostics: The last reload had no problems.
panel.animationHint: Make an animation from scratch: place blocks, items, text and shapes on a timeline, set keyframes and easing, and switch to code at any time.

settings.title: Developer
settings.description: Features for template authors. When off, the app looks the same as usual.
settings.switchHint: Adds a Developer tab to the left panel and a “Developer mode” label to the status bar, and turns on optional modules such as the code editor. You can also toggle it from the View menu.
settings.where1: View menu → Developer mode: turn it on or off at any time.
settings.where2: The Developer tab in the left panel: what you can do with the current template (duplicate a built-in one, open its folder, open the code editor) and hot-reload diagnostics.
settings.where3: Status bar: the “Developer mode” label (click it to jump to the Developer tab), plus the watch status when the current template is your own.
settings.where4: File menu → New animation: the animation editor doesn't need developer mode. In developer mode its code panel uses the built-in code editor.
settings.modulesHint: Features that can be removed as a whole. On by default when developer mode is on; you can turn each off.
settings.noModules: This build has no optional modules.
settings.editorHint: What “Edit animation code” opens. An external editor opens the animation document file itself; saving there updates the main window, and changes made in the app are written back to the file.

anim.converted: “{{name}}” is now a template, under My templates in the library.

commands.setLayerFlags: Hide, solo or lock a layer
commands.setLayerInterval: Change when a layer is visible

history.title: Undo history
history.hint: Click a step to go back to it; you can still redo afterwards.

errors.invalidEdit: That change isn't valid and wasn't applied: {{reason}}
errors.noAnimationFile: This template has no animation.json; it wasn't made from an animation.

layers.title: Layers
layers.empty: No layers yet. Click + at the top right to add a block, item, text or shape.
layers.solo: Solo (show only this layer and its children)
layers.lockedHint: This layer is locked; it can’t be dragged or edited.
layers.ungroupHasTransform: This group has its own position, rotation, scale or opacity; ungrouping would make its layers jump. Reset the group’s transform first.

props.title: Animation
props.name: Name
props.asTemplateHint: Creates a regular template (manifest, code and this animation) under My templates in the library, which you can export as a package to share. The animation itself is unchanged.
props.addKey: Add a keyframe for “{{prop}}” at the current time
props.removeKey: Delete the keyframe for “{{prop}}” at the current time
props.easeHint: Easing applies from this keyframe to the next one. Hold keeps the value until the next keyframe, then jumps.
props.imageHint: Pick a vanilla texture or GUI sprite, or import a picture from this computer (PNG, JPEG, WebP). Nine-slice keeps the border of panels and buttons sharp when stretched; borders are in texture pixels.
props.charsNoRepeat: Turn off the replicator to animate per character
props.charsHint: Each character plays this layer's animation on its own, one after another. Position, rotation and scale are around each character's own center.
props.fromTemplateHint: This animation was opened from the template “{{name}}”. “Update original template” rewrites that template (its presets and projects keep working); “Save as new template” makes another one.

timeline.hint: Drag keyframes to retime · Click a diamond to select · Expand a layer to see its properties
timeline.snapHint: Snap to frames, the playhead, keyframes and sounds (hold Alt while dragging to turn it off)
timeline.zoomHint: Zoom in (Ctrl + wheel zooms at the pointer, Shift + wheel scrolls sideways)
timeline.workArea: Work area: the preview loops within this range (export is not affected)

code.title: Animation code
code.editorHint: Applies when you pause typing · Ctrl+S applies now
code.invalid: The code has a problem; the preview keeps the last working version:

codeWindow.liveHint: Highlights the code in effect at the playhead while playing or scrubbing; click a keyframe in the code to jump to its time
codeWindow.noEditor: The code editor module (optional) isn’t installed. Edit in the Animation code panel of the main window, or open it in an external editor.
codeWindow.noAnimation: The current project isn’t a custom animation
codeWindow.invalid: {{count}} problem(s); the preview keeps the last working version

errors.no-program: No program chosen yet: pick one on the Developer settings page

params.title: Parameters
params.empty: No parameters yet. Pick “Expose as new parameter” from the link button at the right of any row; once converted to a template, it shows up in the Properties panel.
params.label: Name
params.remove: Delete parameter (bound values get its default back)

sounds.add: Add a sound at the playhead
sounds.positionHint: Position is in blocks: +X right, +Y up, −Z straight ahead. With “Spatial audio” on, it fades and pans by the game’s rules; mono sounds only.

keys.hint: Shift or Ctrl click to add to the selection, drag on empty space to box-select; drag to move the group, drag the ends of the selection bar to scale timing; hold Alt to stop snapping; Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V to copy and paste.

graph.empty: The selected layer has no keyframes.
graph.valueHint: Drag squares to change time and value (Shift: value only, Alt: time only), drag handles to change easing
graph.speedHint: Speed: change in value per second, view only
graph.separateHint: Each curve uses its own vertical range (so a small-range property is not flattened next to a large one); the readout follows the last clicked curve

stage.region: Layers on the canvas: click to select, drag to move, drag a corner to scale, drag the dot above to rotate

repeat.title: Replicator
repeat.hint: Each copy plays this layer’s own animation, starting later by its place in the order. Random offsets, random order and random arrangement all come from the seed, so the same seed gives the same result.

path.title: Path
path.hint: Turning it on animates Progress from 0 to 1 over the whole clip, at constant speed along the path; X and Y become offsets from the path. Drag points and handles in the preview; hold Alt and drag from a point to pull out handles.

edited.title: Template code was changed elsewhere
edited.body: This template's template.js no longer matches its animation document (it was probably edited in an external editor). After opening it in the animation editor, “Update original template” regenerates the code from the animation and overwrites those changes.
